publication.title: World Enterprise Incubator
audience: Founders who need a dedicated, steered product team without hiring an office-based one
Investors who read a company evidence pack
publication.thesis: A digital incubator for SaaS: dedicated offshore team seats, steered by WE, that take an idea from validated problem to a company that can prove itself with evidence.
publication.editorial_promise: Plain, accountable and sourced. We say what WE does and what it does not do. No manufactured social proof: where other sites show logos and counters, we show artifacts a reader can open today.
publication.jurisdiction: US (Delaware public benefit corporation, wording pending FLAG-PBC)
publication.risk_profile: regulated-adjacent: financial and legal topics are educational only, never advice, never a promise of funding

creative_direction.selected_thesis: Hive Atlas: an editorial atlas of company building on a light paper ground, charcoal type, blue linework and a single amber lead per component. The hexagon cell is the unit of everything.
creative_direction.motion_metaphor: Dream, Build and Grow are three altitudes of one map: survey, blueprint, territory.
creative_direction.deliberate_refusal: No manufactured social proof: no logo walls, no trusted-by, no metric counters, no testimonials, no synthetic people, no invented founders. The Evidence Ledger replaces them.
reference_teardowns: Rejected: Night Console (logo is dark-on-light only, generic SaaS look)
